stem.text: A student walks at a constant speed for a distance of $50\,\text{m}$ in a time of $40\,\text{s}$. The student rests for a time of $10\,\text{s}$ and then walks back to the starting point at a constant speed in a time of $30\,\text{s}$.
What is the distance–time graph for the motion of the student?

A.alt: Graph of distance / m against time / s. Vertical axis labelled distance / m, marked 0, 50 and 100; horizontal axis labelled time / s, marked 0 to 80.
